summary: Verified SCORM/HTML export background image fix. The bug was caused by '*{background:transparent!important}' CSS rule in player.js (line 1325) and html_exporter.py (line 2017) which overrode ALL inline CSS backgrounds including background images embedded in htmlContent via url(). The fix changed the wildcard rule to '*{box-sizing:border-box!important;max-width:100%!important}' - removing background:transparent from the wildcard selector while keeping it only for body element.

bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Changed '*{background:transparent!important}' to '*{box-sizing:border-box!important;max-width:100%!important}' - removing background:transparent from the wildcard selector while keeping it only for body element.
